body.description: The rationale: reasoning, alternatives considered, deciding factors.

conversationId.description: Provenance: pass the episode sessionId here; decide has no sessionId parameter of its own.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key: a resend returns the first result.

kind.description: Decision category. One of: decision | architecture | policy | process | bugfix | learning | discovery | config.

targetWorkspaceId.description: Write to this workspace UUID instead (needs write/admin; IDs: memory_context).

title.description: The decision in one sentence (e.g. 'Use PostgreSQL as the primary database.').

topicKey.description: Dedup key ('Auth-Strategy' = 'auth-strategy'): the same key updates the decision; without topicKey each call creates one.
